item.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

item.tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

answer_sheet.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

dialog.agent:
I haven’t started a generation: this connection doesn’t provide the account/credit check required before generating, or a timeline editor to reliably combine all three photos with precisely timed text.

Here’s the exact edit plan for your reel:

| Time | Photo & gentle movement | Text |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 sec | **Storefront first**, slow push-in | “Maple Street Café” |
| 3–6 sec | Latte, subtle zoom toward the cup | — |
| 6–9 sec | Pastries, gentle upward pan | “Your morning starts here” |

**Style:** vertical 9:16, warm tones, soft crossfades, cream-coloured text. Soft upbeat acoustic instrumental throughout, no talking, with a short fade-out.

Your Free account supports 480p video. For a café promotion, Magic Hour’s guidance also requires a paid subscription or credit purchase for commercial use.
dialog.why: It says it cannot generate the reel with the available connection because required account/credit checks and timeline editing tools are unavailable. The edit plan is not a finished result.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account has **insufficient credits**, even with free-compatible 480p settings. No video was created and no generation credits were spent.

To make the full 9-second reel using all three photos, you’ll need additional credits—or you can assemble it in Instagram’s editor using the shot order and text timing above.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram café reel using ALL THREE supplied photographs as three consecutive shots in this exact order. Preserve the actual café, food, layout, and photographed details; do not replace them with generic scenes. 0–3 seconds: @storefront first, gently push in on the café façade, with clearly legible title overlay exactly "Maple Street Café". 3–6 seconds: @latte, gentle slow push-in toward the latte on the marble table. 6–9 seconds: @pastries, gentle upward pan over the croissants, with clearly legible closing overlay exactly "Your morning starts here". Soft brief crossfades between shots. Warm natural colours, cosy inviting morning atmosphere, subtle camera movement only. Frame and crop carefully for vertical 9:16. Tasteful cream-coloured text in safe central areas, no extra words or logos. Audio: soft upbeat acoustic instrumental background music, light guitar and gentle percussion, low-key café mood, brief fade out at end. Absolutely no talking, speech, narration or singing.
